_about: Hand-checked values for items scripts/build-items.mjs cannot evaluate statically (LumaItems @ 19587d5). items: builder key -> complete builder fields (or skip). extraItems: registered items made from one abstract builder. astralSets: every piece of each Astral set with its final enchant map.

items/armor/ClownMaskItem.kt#0.note: Head texture varies: one of the clownMasks base64 textures from HeadsYml is picked at random when the item is made; all other fields are fixed.

items/armor/helmet/PalomasVeilItemNest.k.note: Colour varies: one of 4 variants (Red, Lime, Light Blue, Yellow) is picked at random when the item is made, changing the name gradient, the accent colour used in the enchant and lore (#DD9FC7 / #CF9CFA / #F3C7F6 / #F6C7EB) and the Dune armour trim material (redstone / emerald / diamond / gold); Red is shown.

items/misc/ChikosCharmItem.kt#1.note: Material varies: a random dye from the minecraft:dyes item tag (any of the 16 dye colours) is picked when the item is made; White Dye is shown.

items/misc/collectible/PaintballCollecti.note: abstract base builder; its registered items are listed in extraItems

items/misc/LodestarCompassItem.kt#0.note: Fresh (unscanned) state shown; after scanning, the last line is replaced by "Watching <biome>", an optional "Charted by <origin>" line and "N of M scanned". SCAN_RADIUS = 1000 formatted with "%,d" (assumes an English-style default locale).

fields.name: Verdigris Idol
lore: Forged in an age of living metal.

items/misc/VerdigrisIdolItem.kt#0.note: Changes with use: the item is created at the Unoxidized stage (shown) and oxidises through Exposed (25%, EXPOSED_COPPER_GOLEM_STATUE), Weathered (10%, WEATHERED_COPPER_GOLEM_STATUE) and Fully Oxidized (0%, OXIDIZED_COPPER_GOLEM_STATUE), which swaps the material and the last lore line.
